verifications.claim: Artemis II is NASA’s 10-day crewed flight test.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Scheduled for almost 10 days'; R3: 'The approximately 10-day Artemis II mission'; R5: 'Duration: 10 days'; R6: '10-day mission'; R7: 'Mission duration9 days, 1 hour... (planned ~10)'; R9: 'The 10-day Artemis II mission'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly describe Artemis II as a ~10-day crewed test mission.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is scheduled to launch no earlier than September 2025.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'This discovery directly led to the delay of Artemis II’s launch, which was previously scheduled for no earlier than September 2025'; R7: 'In January 2024, the mission was expected to launch in September 2025'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm September 2025 as the no-earlier-than date at one point, matching the cited snippet directly; later delays noted but claim aligns with referenced scheduling info.

verifications.claim: Artemis II will send four astronauts around the Moon and back.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Four astronauts... on a trip around the moon'; R2: 'lifting four astronauts... around the moon but not land there'; R3: 'four astronauts... around the Moon and back'; R5: 'carrying four astronauts on a journey around the Moon and back'
verifications.reasoning: All sources consistently state four astronauts fly around the Moon and back.

verifications.claim: Artemis II marks the first human mission to lunar vicinity since 1972.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'first trip astronauts will take outside Earth orbit since 1972'; R2: 'last time astronauts traveled that far was Apollo 17, in December 1972'; R3: 'first crewed deep-space flight in over 50 years'; R9: 'first time in over 50 years'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state it is the first crewed lunar vicinity mission since Apollo 17 in 1972.
